A concentrated tier 2 venom formula. It hits harder than a standard coating but holds fewer charges.

Effect: Hits with the coated weapon inflict Venom, dealing 8 poison damage every 6 seconds, increased by 20%. Venom lasts 18 seconds, and each new application refreshes it.

Charges: 10. The weapon applies Venom at most once every 6 seconds, and each application spends one charge. Lasting Coatings does not add charges to concentrates.

Venom Expertise and Master Saboteur increase Venom damage. Bonuses are locked in when the coating is applied.

Use: Right-click this vial, choose Activate Item, and select a weapon in your own inventory. One vial is consumed when the coating is applied. Anyone can apply a coating; Poisoncraft is required to craft it.
